consensus.title: User-created event no longer reaches subscribers

responses.content:
* [WARNING] LOGIC User-created event no longer reaches subscribers (in `createUser`)
  - Issue: The publisher now emits `"userCreated"`, but `src/notifications/subscribers.js` subscribes to `"user:created"`. Every successful user creation therefore bypasses both `sendWelcome` and `trackSignup`, causing missing expected side effects. This is an unconditional integration break.
  - Fix: Emit the event name used by the registered subscribers (`bus.emit("user:created", user)`), or update and consistently centralize the event contract across publisher and subscribers.

* [CRITICAL] [LOGIC] Event rename leaves subscribers orphaned (src/users/service.js, bus.emit)
    - Issue: The emitter was renamed from `user:created` to `userCreated`, but `src/notifications/subscribers.js` still registers listeners on `bus.on("user:created", ...)` for both `sendWelcome` and `trackSignup`. Because Node.js EventEmitter matches event names exactly, emitting `userCreated` fires zero listeners. `createUser` still returns the user successfully, so the caller sees a normal 200/create and trusts the signup flow completed — but the welcome email is never sent and signup analytics are never tracked. This triggers on every valid `createUser` call, not just an edge case.
    - Fix: Make the names consistent in one direction. Either revert the emitter to `bus.emit("user:created", user)`, or update both subscribers to `bus.on("userCreated", sendWelcome)` / `bus.on("userCreated", trackSignup)`. Prefer a single source of truth for the event name (e.g., a shared constant exported from a shared module) so the emitter and listeners cannot drift apart again.

* [CRITICAL] CORRECTNESS Event Name Mismatch Breaking Subscribers (at bus.emit in src/users/service.js)
  - Issue: The event name is changed from `"user:created"` to `"userCreated"`, but the subscribers in `src/notifications/subscribers.js` still listen for `"user:created"`. This breaks the contract between emitter and listeners, causing `sendWelcome` and `trackSignup` handlers to never fire. Users won't receive welcome emails and signups won't be tracked.
  - Fix: Either change the event name in both places consistently, or revert the change in service.js. If the new naming convention is intentional, update subscribers.js: `bus.on("userCreated", sendWelcome);` and `bus.on("userCreated", trackSignup);`
